alt: This HHS OIG complaint confirmation page confirms the submission of a hotline complaint against CVS Pharmacy, stating it will be reviewed for relevance and completeness, but notes not all complainants will be contacted.
summary: This HHS OIG complaint confirmation page confirms the submission of a hotline complaint against CVS Pharmacy, stating it will be reviewed for relevance and completeness, but notes not all complainants will be contacted.
full_text: The page states that the complaint has been successfully submitted and will be reviewed for relevance and completeness. It notes that not all complainants will be contacted and that the hotline cannot confirm receipt or provide status updates. A link to the OIG FOIA office is provided. Buttons: Return to HHS-OIG Hotline, Share feedback.
